title: PAXIP1 and STAG2 converge to maintain 3D genome architecture and facilitate promoter/enhancer contacts to enable stress hormone-dependent transcription
model: A549 lung cancer cells treated with hydrocortisone, Brunello library, FACS sort on FKBP5 protein
contrast: FKBP5-low vs FKBP5-high sort, paired by replicate (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: 10 putative hits (FDR < 0.15, LFC > 2.5); NR3C1, STAG2, PAXIP1 top 3
barcs_calls: 1,861 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration (1,944 against the control null); 8 when restricted to guides as abundant as the controls
named_hits: NR3C1 #2, PAXIP1 #12, STAG2 #13 (all FDR <= 1e-4); 10/10 paper hits at FDR 0.10
verdict: BARCS recovers all ten of the paper's hits, with NR3C1, PAXIP1 and STAG2 in its top 13. Its 1,861-gene list is inflated by sparse, jackpotted guides that the far more abundant non-targeting controls cannot calibrate. Restricted to well-counted guides, 8 genes pass, the top six all hits from the paper.
